race.comment: HIGHLIGHT REEL (11) is the danger if he can rebound from being beaten as favourite at Mildura; his St Arnaud placing two back reads well enough and he is third-up and ready to fire. OVERTHINKER (10) has also been readied steadily, with four trials and a close second at Horsham. Respecting for the Bobbin yard. CLASSY SASSY (6) just found one better fresh and Meech aboard is a huge positive, respecting. FROSTED AMBER (7) continues to race well and only has to hold her form to be right around the mark again.
